description: Governor's Secretariat of Sabaragamuwa - Appoint Hon. H. M. R. A. Kumara to inquire the functions
reasoning: This gazette notification concerns the appointment of a retired High Court Judge (a judicial officer) as a single person tribunal of inquiry to investigate alleged wrongful acts by a local government official. The content focuses on judicial/law enforcement matters (appointment of a tribunal with powers under the Commissions of Inquiry Act) rather than general government personnel changes or structural reorganizations.
